description: This file defines the UserTurnProcessor class, a frame processor managing the lifecycle of user turns in a speech or interaction system. It handles events related to user speaking turns, idle detection, and turn start/stop logic, integrating with controllers and emitting relevant frames and events.

classes.name: UserTurnProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor class that manages user turn lifecycle events, including start, stop, idle detection, and interruptions, by coordinating with turn controllers and emitting frames and events accordingly.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UserTurnProcessor with optional strategies, timeouts, and event handlers.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to detect user turn start or stop, and delegates to controllers.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Sets up turn and idle controllers at the start of a user turn.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Cleans up resources at the end of a user turn.

methods.name: _cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a user turn.

methods.name: _cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up turn and idle controllers.

methods.name: _on_broadcast_frame
methods.description: Handles broadcasting frames to other components.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_started
methods.description: Handles user turn start event, emits frames, and calls event handlers.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Handles user turn stop event, emits frames, and calls event handlers.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_stop_timeout
methods.description: Handles turn stop timeout event and calls event handlers.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_idle
methods.description: Handles user idle event and calls event handlers.
